is_anopheles.evidence: Adult collections yielded Anopheles gambiae s.l. (Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles arabiensis) along with minor numbers of An. pharoensis, An. ziemanni, and An. funestus (Page 1, Abstract; Page 4, Table 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Tested for the 'Leu-Phe kdr' mutation (Vgsc L995F / L1014F) and 'ace-1R' mutation (Ace-1 G280S) (Page 4, Page 6, Table 5).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 5 (Page 7) provides exact sample sizes, genotype counts (RR, RS, SS), and allelic frequencies for kdr and ace-1 across three sites: Houeyiho (N=360), Acron (N=360), and Azèrèkè (N=360).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected using pyrethrum spray catches and human landing catches from January to December 2009 in three urban sites in Benin: Houeyiho (Cotonou), Acron (Porto-Novo), and Azèrèkè (Parakou) (Page 2, Study area and Field mosquito collection).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article reporting original entomological and genetic survey data collected in 2009.

sub_country_location.evidence: Specific study sites with GPS coordinates are provided: Houeyiho in Cotonou (6°45'N, 2°31'E), Acron in Porto-Novo (6°30'N, 2°47'E), and Azèrèkè in Parakou (9°22'N, 2°40'E) (Page 2, Methods).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted monthly from January 2009 to December 2009 (Page 2, Methods).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is an original cross-sectional field study conducted in 2009 without indication of re-used external datasets.

supplement.evidence: All relevant genotype counts and frequencies are reported directly in Table 5 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the impact of urban vegetable farming on malaria transmission in three cities in Benin (Cotonou, Porto-Novo, and Parakou) in 2009. A total of 1,080 Anopheles gambiae s.l. collected via indoor pyrethrum spray catches were genotyped for Vgsc L995F (kdr-w) and Ace-1 G280S, with complete sample sizes and genotype distributions reported.
